message.content: In the conversation recorded on 20260910_12:00, Emily Burnett asks LiHua if he has ever encountered someone as quirky and brilliant as Sheldon Cooper, a character from the television show "The Big Bang Theory". LiHua responds, "Not really! I mean, he’s one of a kind, right? I do meet interesting people, but nobody quite like him!" This indicates that LiHua has not met anyone in real life who matches the description of Sheldon Cooper, which is one of the reasons why the character is so fascinating and hard to find in reality.
